tablet.notes:
Crash log now has three parts: Flip phone, Tablet and Home app.
Disconnect now also forgets the old phone's saved voicemails, sync status and default-app line, so a new pairing starts clean.
Also since 621: Mute instead of Snooze, your own PIN, pattern or password lock, Notification settings button, blocked chats hidden, plain sync status.

tablet-regular.notes:
Hold a message: the whole screen goes soft, emoji reactions sit above it and a card of actions below (Forward, Copy, Delete, Select more, Info), like Google Messages. Select more and the Details page match too.
The keyboard closes after you send and when you swipe through the messages. The voice recorder is much smaller. The tablet icon on messages another tablet sent no longer goes missing.
Fixed a crash when opening a video that had been downloaded ahead.
Since the last update: bubbles stop at about three quarters of the width.

messageplus.notes:
Home app update (Home App (Message+) > Update it): turning Message+ Home launcher off now removes it as a home screen, so End never asks "Open with". Turning it on opens the Home app setting. If the phone ever forgets the home screen, it takes you straight to that setting.
Home app problems now show on the tablet (Crash log > Home app).
Muting syncs with the tablet for every number, including short codes.

messageplus_previous.notes:
Muting a conversation now syncs with the tablet for every number, including short codes like 22000 and long numbers (before, those were unmuted again).
Also since build 128: deleting a Not sent text, Sending... until the carrier answers, resend replaces the failed text, blocking and muting shared with the tablet.

tablet2.notes:
Fixes messages showing twice after the phone's history sync, and makes opening the app with a large message history much faster (the cleanup of those copies no longer scans every message again and again).
Also in this copy: the Performance log (Settings > Performance log), and group texts from a new group start their own group.
